text:
zoe (Docs): Hi all — opened a tiny PR: a "Reserved Pool Playbook" that bundles provisioning examples (Terraform, Node SDK), autoscale policy patterns, and a short migration checklist. Need infra + ops sanity check before merge. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pull/1378

rahul (Infra): thanks. Which Node SDK surface did you use in the example?

zoe (Docs): using InfraClient.createPool with provisioningConfig object. Wanted a minimal snippet to show burst_config and kms_key_arn.

mia (SRE): quick ops comments: prefer p95 for latency triggers, cooldown >= 60s, and mention that KV caches are ephemeral and isolated per-tenant. Also, include recommended health thresholds for automated failover.

zoe (Docs): added p95 + 60s cooldown. For failover I proposed: "failover to Hosted if pool healthy_replicas < 75% for 3m or GPU error_rate > 5% for 2m". Good?

owen (Product): that reads OK. Add a single-line customer-facing explainer about billing: "Reserved pools include committed capacity; burst minutes above commitment are pro-rated per minute and billed as usage." Link to pricing page.

zoe (Docs): linked to /pricing/dedicated-reserved. Tess, can Support review the migration checklist wording?
\
tess (Support): one add: "Confirm Redwood service principal has kms:Decrypt on the provided KMS key ARN and test VPC route tables." We get this in onboarding calls.
\
zoe (Docs): added the KMS permission line. Also fixed a dead anchor in the SLA table (old slug for "burst-fallback"). CI complained earlier.

rahul (Infra): infra nit: Terraform attribute is kms_key_arn and burst_config is a block. Example HCL should look like: 

```hcl
resource "redwood_dedicated_pool" "api" {
  name         = "api"
  gpu_type     = "a100-80gb"
  min_capacity = 4
  max_capacity = 16
  kms_key_arn  = "arn:aws:kms:...:key/abcd"
  burst_config = {
    enabled   = true
    max_burst = 6
  }
}
```

zoe (Docs): updated HCL accordingly. For Node snippet I had: 

```js
const InfraClient = require('@redwood/infra').InfraClient;
const client = new InfraClient();
const conf = { gpu_type: 'a100-80gb', min_capacity: 4, max_capacity: 16, burst_config: { enabled: true, max_burst: 6 }, kms_key_arn: 'arn:aws:kms:...:key/abcd' };
const pool = await client.createPool({ name: 'api', provisioningConfig: conf });
console.log(pool.id);
```

rahul (Infra): change createPool param name to provisioningConfig (camelCase) — good catch. Also add a short example for attaching a pinned model: attachModel({ poolId, modelId, pinned: true }).

zoe (Docs): added attachModel snippet. Also included a canary traffic-split example and a short rollback procedure: "If unhealthy, shift 100% to Hosted and notify Support via ticket template."

mia (SRE): add one sentence in isolation section: "Dedicated provides tenant-isolated GPU allocation and per-tenant ephemeral KV caches; control-plane metrics are aggregated for cluster health but tenant-level audit logs remain accessible via API."

zoe (Docs): added that. I also added a short note about preemptible fallback: "Pools using preemptible instances may experience increased tail latency; recommend configuring a fallback route and updating SLOs."

owen (Product): can we include a small table row in the SLA matrix: "Burst fallback: latency SLOs may be relaxed up to 30% during preemptible fallback; billing pro-rated per minute."

zoe (Docs): added SLA row. I also noticed an old link to /pricing/dedicated in another doc and swapped to /pricing/dedicated-reserved across the playbook.
\
tess (Support): approve customer-facing language. Small email template tweak: include a pre-migration checklist item to run kms:Encrypt/decrypt test from the customer's account.

zoe (Docs): added the encrypt/decrypt test line to the migration checklist. doc-ci: can you run the build?
\
doc-ci: docs CI started — https://ci.internal/builds/5139

doc-ci: docs CI passed — https://ci.internal/builds/5139 :white_check_mark:

zoe (Docs): awesome, merging now. I'll post the playbook in #customer-success and tag infra + support for the next wave. Thanks everyone! :tada:
